item.title: Lebanese displaced by war fill Beirut's streets, upending city life
item.summary: Beirut is bursting under a massive wave of displaced people as Israel’s attacks and evacuation orders drive families out of southern and eastern Lebanon and the southern suburbs

item.title: French prosecutors seek detention for 4 suspects in foiled Paris bomb plot
item.summary: French prosecutors have placed four suspects under investigation after police stopped a suspected bomb attack outside a Bank of America building in Paris, with possible links to Iran

item.title: Hiker's dog lost in forest rescued by helicopter after strangers fund search
item.summary: A lost border collie has been rescued alive after her owner fell from a tall waterfall in New Zealand bush

item.title: Fire and explosions cause panic near military camp in Burundi
item.summary: Residents of an area near a military camp in Burundi fled on Tuesday night after explosions were heard coming from the camp, due to what the army spokesperson later said was a fire caused by an electrical fault at the armory

item.title: Russian military plane crashes in annexed Crimea, killing 29 people on board
item.summary: A Russian military plane has crashed in annexed Crimea, killing six crew and 23 passengers on board, Russian news agencies reported in the early hours of Wednesday, citing the country’s Defense Ministry

item.title: Serbian journalists protest reported attacks, pressure on media
item.summary: Dozens of Serbian journalists have blocked traffic outside the offices of populist President Aleksandar Vucic to protest what they say are mounting attacks and pressure on the media in the Balkan country

item.title: Italian coast guard finds 19 migrants dead and rescues 58 from dinghy off Lampedusa
item.summary: The Italian coast guard has found 19 people dead and rescued 58 from a dinghy filled with migrants near Lampedusa

item.title: Business sentiments in Japan improving despite Iran worries
item.summary: A quarterly survey by the Bank of Japan shows business sentiment among major Japanese manufacturers improved slightly

item.title: 3 more men arrested in suspected antisemitic ambulance torching in London
item.summary: London police have arrested three more suspects in the arson attack that burned four ambulances owned by a Jewish charity
